capabilities: Show backlinks with surrounding context for the active note
List outgoing links, backlinks, 2nd-hop related notes, and unlinked mentions
Find and bulk-fix dangling links across the vault with rename, merge, alias, create, and delete actions
Track recently opened files and insert wikilinks by dragging rows
Render in-note backlinks via a code block or an automatic footer
disambiguation: Not a graph visualization tool; it lists link relations in a sidebar rather than drawing the link graph.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; detailed usage, settings, and troubleshooting docs live in separate guides, and beta installs via BRAT are supported.
intentEvidence: Orbital consolidates what previously required three separate plugins.
problem: Obsidian splits link context across separate core panes, and fixing dangling links and tracking recent files each require their own community plugin.

relations.evidence: The MIT-licensed projects (obsidian-relation-pane, obsidian-dangling-links) informed the implementation
